title: Tet4 element (4-node linear tetrahedron, 1-point quadrature)
objective: Add the Tet4 linear tetrahedron: 4 nodes, 1-point Gauss quadrature, linear shape functions. Plug into the existing Element IR infrastructure as a new `ElementType`.
scope: Add `mechdsl.ir.element_ir.tet4_basis()` and `tet4_quadrature()` producing the reference-element basis + single Gauss point.
Add the associated hex8_tables equivalent (`tet4_tables.py`) with SHAPE_AT_QUAD, GRAD_AT_QUAD, QUAD_WEIGHTS arrays emitted as Python list literals.
Update the Taichi printer to accept `ElementType.TET4` in addition to `HEX8`.
implementation_steps: Hand-derive the 4 linear shape functions and the 1-point Gauss rule (weight = 1/6 for unit-volume reference tet).
Extend the element-type dispatch in the codegen.
Unit-test: partition of unity, constant-field exactness, positive Jacobian on a regular tet.
acceptance_criteria: Partition of unity: sum_a N_a = 1 at every quadrature point.
Constant field exactness: interpolating a linear field reproduces it to machine precision.
Positive Jacobian on a regular tet.
risks: Tet4 is a low-order element prone to volumetric locking with incompressible materials. Mitigation: note this in the model docstring and defer mitigation (B-bar, F-bar) to a later task.
completion_notes: Added ElementType.TET4 + tet4 basis/quadrature + tet4_tables.py mirroring hex8_tables.
Widened ElementIR + ProblemIR __post_init__ to accept hex8 and tet4 (others still rejected with Plan B §B5.1 pointer).
Updated 5 guard tests obsoleted by the widened supported-set (test_element_ir.py, test_mechanics_ir.py, test_symbolic_ir_interface.py, test_documentation.py).
Full fast suite: 1167 passed + 31 skipped + 1 expected TODO failure (baseline preserved).
